prompt: Which sentence says: He left without even drinking water?
en: He left without even drinking water.
explain: 都 comes after the thing that follows 连.

zh: 这个问题连老师也不会。
en: Even the teacher cannot do this problem.
explain: 连 + thing + 也 + verb.

en: I even forgot what date it is today.
explain: 连 + thing + 都 + verb.

en: He does not even know one character.
wrong: 他连一个字都也不认识。
explain: Use 都 or 也 after the thing, not both.

prompt: Which sentence says: Even if the weather is not good, we will go?
options: 即使天气不好，我们也要去。
即使天气不好，我们去也要。
zh: 即使天气不好，我们也要去。
en: Even if the weather is not good, we will go.
explain: 也 goes before the verb in the second part.

zh: 即使他不同意，我也要做。
en: Even if he does not agree, I will do it.
explain: 即使 + situation, 也 + result.

en: Even if you do not say it, I know.
explain: 即使 comes first, 也 comes before the verb.

en: Even if I am tired, I will work.
explain: 即使 starts the situation; 也 comes before the verb.

en: Although he was busy, he still came.
explain: 尽管 gives a fact; 还是 gives the result that did not change.

zh: 尽管很难，我们还是做完了。
en: Although it was hard, we still finished it.
explain: 尽管 + situation, 还是 + result.

prompt: Which sentence says: Although the weather is cold, he still wears very little?
options: 尽管天气很冷，他还是穿得很少。
尽管天气很冷，他穿得很少还是。
zh: 尽管天气很冷，他还是穿得很少。
en: Although the weather is cold, he still wears very little.
explain: 还是 comes before the verb part.

zh: 尽管他不喜欢，还是吃了。
en: Although he did not like it, he still ate it.
explain: 尽管 + fact, 还是 + result.

en: Although it was dear, he still bought it.
explain: 尽管 first, 还是 before the verb.

zh: 尽管下雨，我们还是去了。
en: Although it rained, we still went.
explain: 尽管 gives the fact; 还是 starts the result.

prompt: Which sentence says: No matter where you go, I go with you?
options: 不管你去哪儿，我都跟你去。
不管你去哪儿，我跟你去都。
zh: 不管你去哪儿，我都跟你去。
en: No matter where you go, I go with you.
explain: 都 comes before the verb.

zh: 不管天气好不好，他都跑步。
en: Whether the weather is good or not, he runs.
explain: 不管 + question, 都 + result.

en: No matter how hard it is, I want to learn it.
explain: 无论 + question word, 都 + result.

en: No matter who asks, he does not say anything.
explain: 不管 + question word, 都 + result.

en: No matter whether it rains or not, I go.
wrong: 不管如果下不下雨，我都去。
explain: 不管 already means no matter; do not add 如果.

prompt: Which sentence says: If you do not feel well, go home and rest?
options: 要是你不舒服，就回家休息吧。
你不舒服要是，就回家休息吧。
zh: 要是你不舒服，就回家休息吧。
en: If you do not feel well, go home and rest.
explain: 要是 comes before the situation.

zh: 要是明天不忙，我们就去看电影。
en: If we are not busy tomorrow, we will go and see a film.
explain: 要是 + situation, 就 + result.

en: If he comes, I will leave.
explain: 要是 first, 就 before the result.

en: If you want to go, tell me.
wrong: 要是如果你想去，就告诉我。
explain: 要是 and 如果 both mean if; use only one.

zh: 既然你不喜欢，就别买吧。
en: Since you do not like it, do not buy it.
explain: 既然 accepts that the fact is true.

en: Since you want to go, go.
explain: 既然 + known fact, 就 + advice.

prompt: Which sentence says: Since you do not want to eat, I will not cook any more?
options: 既然你不想吃，我就不做了。
既然你不想吃，我不就做了。
zh: 既然你不想吃，我就不做了。
en: Since you do not want to eat, I will not cook any more.
explain: 就 comes before 不.

zh: 既然你有时间，就帮我一下吧。
en: Since you have time, help me a little.
explain: 既然 + fact, 就 + suggestion.

zh: 既然大家都来了，就开始吧。
en: Since everyone has come, let us begin.
explain: 既然 + fact, 就 + suggestion.

zh: 既然你累了，就早一点睡吧。
en: Since you are tired, go to bed a little earlier.
wrong: 既然因为你累了，就早一点睡吧。
explain: 既然 already gives the reason; do not add 因为.

prompt: Which sentence says: You must drink more water, or you will feel unwell?
options: 你要多喝水，否则会不舒服。
你要多喝水，会不舒服否则。
zh: 你要多喝水，否则会不舒服。
en: You must drink more water, or you will feel unwell.
explain: 否则 starts the second part.

zh: 快走吧，否则我们要迟到了。
en: Let us go quickly, or we will be late.
explain: Situation, 否则 + bad result.

en: Go now, or it will be too late.
explain: 否则 comes before the bad result.

en: You must be careful, or you will get ill.
wrong: 你要小心，但是否则会生病。
explain: 否则 already joins the two parts; do not add 但是.

zh: 由于太忙，因此他没有时间吃饭。
en: Because he is too busy, he has no time to eat.
explain: 由于 + reason, 因此 + result.

zh: 由于身体不好，因此他不能去。
en: Because his health is bad, he cannot go.
explain: 由于 starts the reason.

prompt: Which sentence says: Because it snowed heavily, the school had a holiday?
options: 由于下大雪，因此学校放假了。
下大雪由于，因此学校放假了。
zh: 由于下大雪，因此学校放假了。
en: Because it snowed heavily, the school had a holiday.
explain: 由于 starts the reason.

zh: 由于路上堵车，因此我迟到了。
en: Because of the traffic jam, I was late.
explain: 由于 + reason, 因此 + result.

zh: 由于天气不好，因此飞机晚点了。
en: Because the weather was not good, the plane was late.
explain: 由于 + reason, 因此 + result.

zh: 由于他很忙，因此没有来。
en: Because he was busy, he did not come.
wrong: 由于因为他很忙，因此没有来。
explain: 由于 and 因为 both mean because; use only one.

zh: 她看见朋友，于是走了过去。
en: She saw her friend, so she walked over.
explain: 于是 links two actions in order.

zh: 他有点儿渴，于是喝了一杯水。
en: He was a little thirsty, so he drank a glass of water.
explain: 于是 + what he did about it.

en: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
explain: 于是 = so, and then.

prompt: Which sentence says: I was hungry, so I went and bought a bread roll?
options: 我很饿，于是去买了一个面包。
我很饿，去买了一个面包于是。
zh: 我很饿，于是去买了一个面包。
en: I was hungry, so I went and bought a bread roll.
explain: 于是 comes before the second action.

zh: 天气很热，于是我们去游泳了。
en: It was hot, so we went swimming.
explain: 于是 links a situation with what was done next.

zh: 下雨了，于是我们回家了。
en: It started to rain, so we went home.
explain: 于是 + what was done.

en: He was tired, so he went to sleep.
wrong: 他很累，所以于是睡觉了。
explain: 于是 already means so; do not add 所以.

zh: 我想去，不过今天太累了。
en: I want to go, but I am too tired today.
explain: 不过 = but.

prompt: Which sentence says: This dish is tasty, but a little spicy?
options: 这个菜很好吃，不过有点儿辣。
这个菜很好吃，有点儿辣不过。
zh: 这个菜很好吃，不过有点儿辣。
en: This dish is tasty, but a little spicy.
explain: 不过 starts the part that contrasts.

en: He is clever, but he does not work hard.
explain: 然而 starts the contrast.

zh: 我想帮你，不过没有时间。
en: I want to help you, but I have no time.
explain: 不过 starts the second part.

en: The house is big, but old.
wrong: 房子很大，但是不过很旧。
explain: 不过 already means but; do not add 但是.

en: He is clever, and he works hard too.
explain: 并且 adds a second good thing.

zh: 我喜欢咖啡，而我的朋友喜欢茶。
en: I like coffee, while my friend likes tea.
explain: 而 shows the two sides.

prompt: Which sentence says: He can drive, and he drives well?
options: 他会开车，并且开得很好。
他会开车，开得很好并且。
zh: 他会开车，并且开得很好。
en: He can drive, and he drives well.
explain: 并且 comes at the start of the added part.

zh: 这本书很有意思，并且很便宜。
en: This book is interesting, and it is cheap too.
explain: 并且 adds another point.

zh: 我喜欢夏天，而他喜欢冬天。
en: I like summer, while he likes winter.
explain: 而 sets two things side by side.

en: She is clever, and she works hard too.
wrong: 她很聪明，并且而且很努力。
explain: 并且 already means and also; do not add 而且.

prompt: Which sentence says: This phone is both cheap and easy to use?
options: 这个手机既便宜又好用。
zh: 这个手机既便宜又好用。
en: This phone is both cheap and easy to use.
explain: 既 needs 又 for the second quality.

zh: 我们的老师既年轻又热情。
en: Our teacher is both young and warm.
explain: 既 + quality 1, 又 + quality 2.

en: He is both clever and hardworking.
explain: 既 + quality 1, 又 + quality 2.

zh: 这家饭店既干净又安静。
en: This restaurant is both clean and quiet.
wrong: 这家饭店既很干净又安静。
explain: Do not put 很 after 既.

zh: 我不是不喜欢他，而是不了解他。
en: It is not that I dislike him; I do not know him well.
explain: 而 comes before 是 and gives the true idea.

en: I am not tired; I am hungry.
explain: 不是 + wrong idea, 而是 + true idea.

prompt: Which sentence says: It is not that I do not want to go; I have no time?
options: 我不是不想去，而是没有时间。
我不是不想去，是而没有时间。
zh: 我不是不想去，而是没有时间。
en: It is not that I do not want to go; I have no time.
explain: The word is 而是, in that order.

en: He is not a doctor but a teacher.
explain: 不是 + A, 而是 + B.

en: She is not crying; she is laughing.
explain: 不是 + A, 而是 + B.

en: This is not mine but his.
wrong: 这不是我的，但是而是他的。
explain: 不是…而是… already contrasts; do not add 但是.

zh: 首先要吃饭，其次要休息。
en: First you must eat; second you must rest.
explain: 其次 gives the second point.

prompt: Which sentence says: First you must buy a ticket; second you must find a seat?
options: 首先要买票，其次要找座位。
其次要买票，首先要找座位。
zh: 首先要买票，其次要找座位。
en: First you must buy a ticket; second you must find a seat.
explain: 首先 comes first, 其次 comes second.

zh: 首先要学习，其次要锻炼身体。
en: First you must study; second you must exercise.
explain: 首先 for the first point, 其次 for the second.

zh: 首先要有信心，其次要努力。
en: First you must have confidence; second you must work hard.
explain: 首先 for the first point, 其次 for the second.

zh: 首先要休息，其次要多喝水。
en: First you must rest; second you must drink more water.
wrong: 首先要休息，其次然后要多喝水。
explain: 其次 already marks the second point; do not add 然后.

zh: 他很聪明；此外，他也很努力。
en: He is clever; in addition, he works hard too.
explain: 此外 is the formal "in addition".

zh: 这个城市很大；另外，人也很多。
en: This city is big; besides, it has many people.
explain: 另外 starts the new point.

prompt: Which sentence says: I have class today; besides, I also have to go to the bank?
options: 我今天要上课；另外，还要去银行。
我今天要上课；还要去银行，另外。
zh: 我今天要上课；另外，还要去银行。
en: I have class today; besides, I also have to go to the bank.
explain: 另外 starts the added part.

zh: 这个手机很好；此外，价格也不高。
en: This phone is good; in addition, the price is not high either.
explain: 此外 adds another point.

zh: 他会唱歌；另外，他也会跳舞。
en: He can sing; besides, he can dance too.
explain: 另外 adds another point.

zh: 他喜欢看书；此外，他也喜欢画画。
en: He likes reading; in addition, he likes drawing too.
wrong: 他喜欢看书；此外，但是他也喜欢画画。
explain: 此外 adds; it does not contrast, so do not add 但是.

zh: 我爱吃甜的东西，比如西瓜。
en: I love sweet things, for example watermelon.
explain: 比如 introduces examples.

zh: 他爱吃甜的东西，例如面包。
en: He loves sweet things, for example bread.
explain: 例如 comes right before the example.

prompt: Which sentence says: I have been to many countries, for example China and America?
options: 我去过很多国家，例如中国和美国。
我去过很多国家，中国和美国例如。
zh: 我去过很多国家，例如中国和美国。
en: I have been to many countries, for example China and America.
explain: 例如 comes before the examples.

zh: 他会做很多菜，比如鱼和鸡蛋。
en: He can cook many dishes, for example fish and eggs.
explain: 比如 + examples.

zh: 我喜欢运动，比如跑步和游泳。
en: I like sports, for example running and swimming.
explain: 比如 + examples.

zh: 我喜欢动物，比如猫和狗。
en: I like animals, for example cats and dogs.
explain: The examples follow 比如 directly.

zh: 这个办法很好，同时也很简单。
en: This way is good, and at the same time simple.
explain: 同时 = at the same time.

zh: 她在听音乐，同时在做作业。
en: She is listening to music and doing homework at the same time.
explain: 同时 joins the two actions.

prompt: Which sentence says: He is studying Chinese, and at the same time studying music?
options: 他在学习汉语，同时也在学习音乐。
他在学习汉语，也在学习音乐同时。
zh: 他在学习汉语，同时也在学习音乐。
en: He is studying Chinese, and at the same time studying music.
explain: 同时 comes before the second action.

zh: 我们要努力工作，同时也要注意休息。
en: We must work hard, and at the same time we must take care to rest.
explain: 同时 joins two things done together.

zh: 他唱歌的同时，还在跳舞。
en: While he sings, he is also dancing.
explain: …的同时 means while.

zh: 她在做饭，同时在听音乐。
en: She is cooking and listening to music at the same time.
wrong: 她在做饭，同时然后在听音乐。
explain: 同时 means at the same time; do not add 然后 (afterwards).

en: He is tired; he does not even want to talk.
explain: 甚至 adds a stronger case.

en: It is very cold; it has even started to snow.
explain: 甚至 comes before the stronger case.

prompt: Which sentence says: He even forgot his own name?
options: 他甚至忘了自己的名字。
他忘了甚至自己的名字。
zh: 他甚至忘了自己的名字。
en: He even forgot his own name.
explain: 甚至 comes before the verb.

prompt: Which sentence says: He is very busy; he does not even have time to sleep?
options: 他很忙，甚至没有时间睡觉。
他很忙，没有甚至时间睡觉。
zh: 他很忙，甚至没有时间睡觉。
en: He is very busy; he does not even have time to sleep.
explain: 甚至 comes before the surprising part.

zh: 他生气了，甚至不想和我说话。
en: He got angry; he does not even want to speak with me.
explain: 甚至 adds a stronger case.

zh: 这个字很难，甚至老师也不认识。
en: This character is hard; even the teacher does not know it.
explain: 甚至 + the surprising person or thing.

en: He was so tired that he did not manage to walk any more.
wrong: 他累得甚至而且走不动了。
explain: 甚至 already adds a stronger case; do not add 而且.

zh: 没有出租车，我们只好走路回家。
en: There are no taxis, so we have to walk home.
explain: 只好 = the only thing left is to.

zh: 车坏了，他不得不走路去。
en: His car has broken down, so he has to walk.
explain: 不得不 comes before the verb.

prompt: Which sentence says: I have no money any more, so I have to walk home?
options: 没有钱了，我只好走路回家。
没有钱了，我走路只好回家。
zh: 没有钱了，我只好走路回家。
en: I have no money any more, so I have to walk home.
explain: 只好 comes before the whole action.

zh: 太晚了，他不得不打车回家。
en: It was too late, so he had to take a taxi home.
explain: 不得不 + the thing you have to do.

en: He has to change jobs.
explain: 不得不 comes before the verb.

en: We have to wait until tomorrow.
wrong: 我们只好不得不等到明天。
explain: 只好 and 不得不 both mean have to; use only one.

zh: 快一点走，否则就来不及了。
en: Hurry, or it will be too late.
explain: 来不及 = too late.

en: There is still time to set off now.
explain: 来得及 = there is still time.

prompt: Which sentence says: There are only 10 minutes left; there is no time to eat any more?
options: 只有十分钟了，来不及吃饭了。
只有十分钟了，来不及了吃饭。
zh: 只有十分钟了，来不及吃饭了。
en: There are only 10 minutes left; there is no time to eat any more.
explain: 来不及 comes before the thing you have no time for.

en: Do not worry; we are still in time.
explain: 来得及 means there is still time.

en: We are in time to catch the train.
explain: 来得及 + verb.

zh: 他起得太晚，来不及吃早饭。
en: He gets up too late, so he has no time to eat breakfast.
wrong: 他起得太晚，来不及没吃早饭。
explain: 来不及 already means there is no time; do not add 没.

en: Call him right away.
explain: 赶紧 goes before the verb.

en: He quickly ran home.
explain: 赶快 goes before the verb.

prompt: Which sentence says: Close the door quickly?
en: Close the door quickly.
explain: 赶快 comes before the verb part.

zh: 天要下雨了，我们赶紧回家吧。
en: It is going to rain; let us hurry home.
explain: 赶紧 + action.

en: He quickly stood up.
explain: 赶快 comes before the verb.

en: You had better go right away.
explain: 赶紧 goes before the verb.

zh: 难道他不知道这件事吗？
en: Does he really not know about this?
explain: 难道 shows surprise.

en: Have you really forgotten?
explain: 难道 + statement + 吗.

prompt: Which sentence says: Are you really not tired at all??
options: 难道你一点儿也不累吗？
zh: 难道你一点儿也不累吗？
en: Are you really not tired at all?
explain: 难道 comes first and 吗 comes at the end.

en: Did you really not see it?
explain: 难道 … 吗 asks a question that doubts.

en: Has he really left already?
explain: 难道 first, 吗 last.

en: Do you really want to go?
wrong: 难道如果你想去吗？
explain: 难道 starts a question that doubts; do not add 如果.

prompt: Which sentence says: Whom on earth do you like??
en: Whom on earth do you like?
explain: 到底 comes before the verb.

zh: 这件事究竟是怎么回事？
en: What on earth is going on with this matter?
explain: 究竟 asks for the real answer.

en: Has he come or not?
explain: 到底 comes before the verb.

en: What on earth do you want?
wrong: 你到底究竟想要什么？
explain: 到底 and 究竟 mean the same; use only one.

en: He actually went alone.
explain: 竟然 shows surprise.

prompt: Which sentence says: She actually went travelling alone?
options: 她竟然一个人去旅游了。
她竟然去一个人旅游了。
zh: 她竟然一个人去旅游了。
en: She actually went travelling alone.
explain: 一个人 comes before the verb.

zh: 这么简单的问题，他竟然不会。
en: He actually cannot do such an easy question.
explain: 竟然 shows surprise.

zh: 我竟然忘了今天是你的生日。
en: I actually forgot that today is your birthday.
explain: 竟然 comes before the verb.

en: He actually did not come.
wrong: 他竟然但是没有来。
explain: 竟然 shows surprise; do not add 但是.

zh: 我本来不饿，可是看见饭就想吃了。
en: I was not hungry at first, but I want to eat when I see food.
explain: 本来 = at first.

en: So this is your book.
explain: 原来 starts the sentence.

prompt: Which sentence says: I originally wanted to leave earlier, but I was too tired?
options: 我本来想早一点走，可是太累了。
我想早一点走本来，可是太累了。
zh: 我本来想早一点走，可是太累了。
en: I originally wanted to leave earlier, but I was too tired.
explain: 本来 comes before the verb.

en: So you like swimming too!
explain: 原来 shows you have just found something out.

en: He is busy to begin with.
explain: 本来 means in the first place.

en: This is not hard to begin with.
wrong: 这本来原来不难。
explain: 本来 and 原来 are different words; do not use both.

prompt: Which sentence says: This problem really is hard?
en: This problem really is hard.
explain: 确实 comes before the quality word.

en: He is very busy today.
explain: 十分 means very.

en: I really do not want to go.
explain: 实在 comes before 不.

en: She completely understands what I mean.
explain: 完全 comes before the verb.

en: He is very happy.
wrong: 他十分非常高兴。
explain: 十分 already means very; do not add 非常.

en: I have never seen him.
explain: 从来没 means "never up to now".

prompt: Which sentence says: He is never late?
en: He is never late.
explain: 从来 comes before 不.

zh: 我从来没有去过那个地方。
en: I have never been to that place.
explain: 从来 + 没有 or 不.

en: She never drinks alcohol.
explain: 从来 + 不 + verb.

zh: 我从来没有吃过这个菜。
en: I have never eaten this dish.
wrong: 我从来没有一直吃过这个菜。
explain: 从来 already means all along; do not add 一直.

en: I am not tired at all.
explain: 并不 = not at all.

en: This is not hard at all.
explain: 并 comes before 不.

prompt: Which sentence says: This problem is not hard at all?
en: This problem is not hard at all.
explain: 并 comes right before 不.

en: He did not actually say it wrong.
explain: 并 comes right before 不 or 没.

en: I do not actually want to go.
explain: 并 comes right before 不.

en: He is not happy at all.
wrong: 他并比较不高兴。
explain: 并 must come right before 不 or 没.

en: Here it tends to be cold in winter.
explain: 往往 describes what usually happens.

en: Students tend not to like exams.
explain: 往往 goes before 不.

prompt: Which sentence says: At weekends the shop tends to be crowded?
options: 周末商店里往往人很多。
周末商店里人很多往往。
zh: 周末商店里往往人很多。
en: At weekends the shop tends to be crowded.
explain: 往往 comes before the verb or quality word.

zh: 孩子们往往喜欢甜的东西。
en: Children tend to like sweet things.
explain: 往往 describes what usually happens.

en: It tends to be hot here in summer.
explain: 往往 comes before the quality word.

en: Teachers tend to be busy.
wrong: 老师往往常常很忙。
explain: 往往 already means often; do not add 常常.

en: He drinks a cup of coffee now and then.
explain: 偶尔 = now and then.

prompt: Which sentence says: He is always late?
en: He is always late.
explain: 老是 comes before the verb.

en: I watch TV now and then.
explain: 偶尔 means now and then.

en: He keeps asking questions.
explain: 不断地 comes before the verb.

en: She is always forgetting to bring her key.
explain: 老是 goes before the verb.

en: He nearly forgot to bring his phone.
explain: 差点儿 = nearly.

en: I almost fell asleep.
explain: 差点儿 goes before the verb.

prompt: Which sentence says: He was almost late?
en: He was almost late.
explain: 差点儿 comes before the verb.

zh: 我差点儿忘了你的生日。
en: I almost forgot your birthday.
explain: 差点儿 means almost, and it did not happen.

en: He almost cried.
explain: 差点儿 comes before the verb.

en: He almost fell asleep.
wrong: 他差点儿几乎睡着了。
explain: 差点儿 already means almost; do not add 几乎.

en: This book has about 200 pages.
explain: 大约 = about.

en: I must study at least two years.
explain: 至少 goes before the amount.

prompt: Which sentence says: This piece of clothing is about 500 yuan?
en: This piece of clothing is about 500 yuan.
explain: 大约 comes before the number.

en: He is about 30 years old.
explain: 左右 comes after the number.

en: I sleep at least 8 hours.
explain: 至少 comes before the verb.

zh: 教室里大约有二十个学生。
en: There are about 20 students in the classroom.
explain: 大约 comes before the number.

zh: 他每天至少学习两个小时。
en: He studies at least 2 hours every day.
wrong: 他每天至少大约学习两个小时。
explain: 至少 means at least; do not add 大约 (about).

zh: 这里夏天很热，尤其是八月。
en: It is hot here in summer, especially in August.
explain: 尤其 = especially.

zh: 有十个人，其中三个是老师。
en: There are ten people, and three of them are teachers.
explain: 其中 points back to the ten.

prompt: Which sentence says: I like animals, especially dogs?
en: I like animals, especially dogs.
explain: The order is 尤其是.

zh: 班里有二十个学生，其中十个是男的。
en: There are 20 students in the class, and 10 of them are male.
explain: 其中 points back to the group just named.

zh: 他喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
en: He likes fruit, especially apples.
explain: 尤其是 picks out the main case.

zh: 我喜欢旅游，尤其是夏天。
en: I like travelling, especially in summer.
wrong: 我喜欢旅游，尤其是特别夏天。
explain: 尤其 already means especially; do not add 特别.

en: I guess he will not come.
explain: 估计 = I guess.

en: This question is definitely hard.
explain: 肯定 = definitely.

en: Maybe he does not know.
explain: 也许 goes before the verb.

prompt: Which sentence says: Maybe he has already gone home?
en: Maybe he has already gone home.
explain: 也许 comes before 已经.

en: I am afraid it will rain tomorrow.
explain: 恐怕 gives a guess that is not good news.

en: He will definitely agree.
explain: 肯定 means for sure.

en: I guess he has already arrived.
explain: 估计 + guess.

en: Maybe he knows about this matter.
explain: 也许 comes before the verb.

en: He definitely does not know.
wrong: 他肯定也许不知道。
explain: 肯定 and 也许 have opposite strength; do not use both.

en: Be sure not to tell him.
explain: 千万 gives a strong warning.

en: I cannot answer.
explain: 无法 goes before the verb.

prompt: Which sentence says: Be sure not to tell others?
en: Be sure not to tell others.
explain: 千万 comes before 不要.

en: I cannot explain this matter.
explain: 无法 means cannot.

en: You must be sure not to get angry.
explain: 千万 comes before 别.

en: I cannot agree with you.
wrong: 我无法能同意你。
explain: 无法 already means cannot; do not add 能.

zh: 已经很晚了，他仍然在工作。
en: It is already late, and he is still working.
explain: 仍然 = still.

en: She still does not know about this.
explain: 仍然 goes before 不.

prompt: Which sentence says: It rains hard, and he still goes to work?
en: It rains hard, and he still goes to work.
explain: 仍然 comes before the verb.

zh: 已经十点了，她仍然没睡。
en: It is already 10 o'clock, and she still has not slept.
explain: 仍然 means still.

en: He still lives here.
explain: 仍然 comes before the verb.

en: I still do not understand.
explain: 仍然 goes before 不.

en: Please go on speaking.
explain: 继续 = go on.

en: In the end he found a job.
explain: 最终 = in the end.

en: I will start again from the beginning.
explain: 重新 goes before the verb.

prompt: Which sentence says: You rest first, and then continue working?
options: 你先休息，然后继续工作。
你先休息，然后工作继续。
zh: 你先休息，然后继续工作。
en: You rest first, and then continue working.
explain: 继续 comes before the verb.

zh: 这个字写错了，请重新写。
en: This character was written wrong; please write it again.
explain: 重新 means again from the start.

zh: 经过很多努力，他最终成功了。
en: After a lot of effort, he finally succeeded.
explain: 最终 gives the end result.

en: We will continue the meeting tomorrow.
explain: 继续 comes before the verb.

en: He looked for a job again.
explain: 重新 comes before the verb.

en: In the end he agreed.
wrong: 最终他终于同意了。
explain: 最终 and 终于 both mean finally; use only one.

prompt: Which sentence says: It is a bit cold today?
en: It is a bit cold today.
explain: 有点儿 comes before the quality word.

en: Please be a little faster.
explain: 稍微 + a small change.

en: I am a bit tired now.
explain: 有点儿 comes before the quality word.

en: He is a little taller.
wrong: 他稍微很高一点。
explain: 稍微 already means a little; do not add 很.

en: How good the weather is here!
explain: 多么 + adjective + 啊.

en: How happy the children are!
explain: 多么 comes before the adjective.

prompt: Which sentence says: How cute this cat is!?
en: How cute this cat is!
explain: 多么 comes before the quality word.

en: How clever you are!
explain: 多么 + quality + 啊 makes an exclamation.

en: How big this city is!
explain: 多么 comes before the quality word.

en: How hard he works!
wrong: 他多么很努力啊！
explain: 多么 already means how; do not add 很.

zh: 这个菜看起来一般，吃起来倒很好吃。
en: This dish looks ordinary, but it tastes very good.
explain: 倒 = contrary to what you expect.

en: He is busy, but he still came.
explain: 却 goes before 还是.

en: I want to go, but he does not want to go.
explain: 却 turns the meaning against the first part.

prompt: Which sentence says: The weather is good, but he is sleeping at home?
options: 天气很好，他却在家睡觉。
天气很好，却他在家睡觉。
zh: 天气很好，他却在家睡觉。
en: The weather is good, but he is sleeping at home.
explain: 却 comes after the person, before the verb.

zh: 这个房间不大，倒很干净。
en: This room is not big, but it is clean.
explain: 倒 shows a result you did not expect.

en: I told him, but he forgot.
explain: 却 comes after the person, before the verb.

en: We are tired, but he is very happy.
wrong: 我们很累，并且他却很高兴。
explain: 却 already shows the contrast; do not add 并且 (and).

en: Winter here is even colder.
explain: 更加 = even more.

en: I am not as clever as my older brother.
explain: A 不如 B + adjective.

prompt: Which sentence says: Today is even hotter than yesterday?
en: Today is even hotter than yesterday.
explain: 更加 comes right before the quality word.

en: This way is not as good as that one.
explain: A 不如 B + quality.

en: He studies even more seriously now.
explain: 更加 means even more.

en: My room is not as big as yours.
explain: A 不如 B + quality.

en: She is even taller than me.
wrong: 她比我更加很高。
explain: 更加 already means even more; do not add 很.

en: For students, this is hard.
explain: 对 + person + 来说.

en: He is very serious about studying.
explain: 对于 + topic.

prompt: Which sentence says: For students, this book is very useful?
options: 对学生来说，这本书很有用。
对来说学生，这本书很有用。
zh: 对学生来说，这本书很有用。
en: For students, this book is very useful.
explain: 对 + person + 来说.

zh: 对于这个问题，大家的看法不一样。
en: On this question, everyone's views are not the same.
explain: 对于 + topic.

zh: 对老人来说，走路很重要。
en: For old people, walking is very important.
explain: 对 + person + 来说.

zh: 对于这个问题，我没有意见。
en: On this question, I have no opinion.
wrong: 对于关于这个问题，我没有意见。
explain: 对于 and 关于 both mean about; do not use both.

en: He has passed the exam.
explain: 通过 can mean "to pass".

zh: 通过朋友，我找到了工作。
en: Through a friend, I found a job.
explain: 通过 + person or means.

prompt: Which sentence says: Through hard work, he got the chance?
options: 通过努力，他得到了机会。
努力通过，他得到了机会。
zh: 通过努力，他得到了机会。
en: Through hard work, he got the chance.
explain: 通过 comes before the way or means.

zh: 通过这次旅行，我了解了很多。
en: Through this trip, I learned a lot.
explain: 通过 + the way or means.

zh: 通过练习，她的汉语好多了。
en: Through practice, her Chinese is much better.
explain: 通过 + means, then the result.

en: He passed the exam.
wrong: 他通过经过了考试。
explain: 通过 and 经过 are different words; do not use both.

zh: 随着天气变冷，雨越来越多。
en: As the weather gets cold, there is more and more rain.
explain: 随着 + change.

zh: 随着城市变大，路越来越多。
en: As the city grows, there are more and more roads.
explain: 随着 starts the sentence.

prompt: Which sentence says: As the weather gets cold, people wear more and more?
options: 随着天气变冷，人们穿得越来越多。
天气变冷随着，人们穿得越来越多。
zh: 随着天气变冷，人们穿得越来越多。
en: As the weather gets cold, people wear more and more.
explain: 随着 comes first.

zh: 随着生活变好，大家越来越高兴。
en: As life gets better, everyone gets happier and happier.
explain: 随着 + change, then 越来越.

zh: 随着时间过去，他忘了很多。
en: As time goes by, he has forgotten a lot.
explain: 随着 + change, then the result.

zh: 随着天气变热，他喝水越来越多。
en: As the weather gets hot, he drinks more and more water.
wrong: 随着因为天气变热，他喝水越来越多。
explain: 随着 already gives the background; do not add 因为.

zh: 按照地图走，我们找到了银行。
en: Following the map, we found the bank.
explain: 按照 + what you follow.

en: As a teacher, she is very serious.
explain: 作为 + role.

prompt: Which sentence says: Please do the homework the way the teacher says?
options: 请按照老师说的做作业。
请老师说的按照做作业。
zh: 请按照老师说的做作业。
en: Please do the homework the way the teacher says.
explain: 按照 comes before what you follow.

zh: 作为学生，我们要努力学习。
en: As students, we must study hard.
explain: 作为 + role.

en: We have class according to the timetable.
explain: 按照 + what you follow.

en: As the manager, he is very busy.
wrong: 作为是经理，他很忙。
explain: 作为 already means as; do not add 是.

zh: 和他相比，我的汉语不太好。
en: Compared with him, my Chinese is not very good.
explain: 和 … 相比 = compared with.

prompt: Which sentence says: Compared with before, it is cleaner here now?
options: 与以前相比，这里更干净了。
与相比以前，这里更干净了。
zh: 与以前相比，这里更干净了。
en: Compared with before, it is cleaner here now.
explain: 与 + thing + 相比.

zh: 与哥哥相比，我更喜欢运动。
en: Compared with my older brother, I like sports more.
explain: 与 + thing + 相比.

en: Compared with summer, winter is colder.
explain: 与 + thing + 相比, then the result.

en: Compared with him, I am not very tall.
wrong: 和他相比，但是我不太高。
explain: 和…相比 sets up the comparison; do not add 但是.

zh: 这个电影使我想起了小时候。
en: This film reminds me of my childhood.
explain: 使 + person + result.

en: This matter makes him very sad.
explain: 使 + person + feeling.

prompt: Which sentence says: This news makes me very happy?
en: This news makes me very happy.
explain: 使 + person + result.

en: Sport makes the body healthier.
explain: 使 means make.

en: This matter makes me very angry.
explain: 使 + person + result.

zh: 这个好消息使她很高兴。
en: This good news makes her very happy.
wrong: 这个好消息使让她很高兴。
explain: 使 and 让 both mean make; use only one.

prompt: Which sentence says: As soon as I get home, I wash my hands?
en: As soon as I get home, I wash my hands.
explain: 一 comes before the first verb.

en: He understood as soon as he heard it.
explain: 一 + first action, 就 + second action.

en: She laughed as soon as she saw me.
explain: 一 + first action, 就 + second action.

en: As soon as I get home, I sleep.
wrong: 我一到家就才睡觉。
explain: 一…就… already means as soon as; do not add 才.

en: I have no questions at all.
explain: 任何 + noun.

en: Eat anything here as you like.
explain: 随便 = as you like.

en: Anyone can help you.
explain: 任何 + noun + 都.

prompt: Which sentence says: No one can go in?
en: No one can go in.
explain: 都 comes right after 任何人.

en: Order whatever you want to eat.
explain: 随便 means as you like.

en: I have no way at all.
explain: 任何 + noun, with a negative.

en: Anyone can take part.
wrong: 所有任何人都可以参加。
explain: 任何 already covers everyone; do not add 所有.

en: Students from every country have come.
explain: 各 + noun = each.

en: Everything is dear.
explain: 所有 + noun + 都.

prompt: Which sentence says: All the students have come?
en: All the students have come.
explain: 都 comes before the verb.

en: All the phones are here.
explain: 所有 + 的 + noun, then 都.

en: Everything will be fine.
explain: 一切 is followed by 都.

en: Everyone is very happy.
wrong: 所有的人都全很高兴。
explain: 所有 already means all; do not add 全.

en: He ate all the dishes.
explain: 全部 = all of it.

en: This city has many parks.
explain: 许多 + noun.

en: I only watched part of it.
explain: 一部分 = a part.

prompt: Which sentence says: He has done a lot of work?
en: He has done a lot of work.
explain: 许多 comes before the noun.

en: It snowed in the whole city.
explain: 整个 means the whole.

en: I read part of this book.
explain: 部分 means part.

en: I have already spent a lot of money.
explain: 大量 + 的 + noun.

en: Everyone has arrived.
explain: 全部 means all of them.

en: He bought many books.
wrong: 他买了许多大量书。
explain: 许多 and 大量 both mean many; use only one.

zh: 有的人看书，有的人聊天。
en: Some people read and some chat.
explain: 有的 … 有的 … splits the group.

zh: 这些书，有的好，有的不好。
en: Of these books, some are good and some are not.
explain: 有的 … 有的 … compares the parts.

prompt: Which sentence says: Some students are here and some are not?
options: 有的学生在这儿，有的不在。
有的学生在这儿，有的学生不是在。
zh: 有的学生在这儿，有的不在。
en: Some students are here and some are not.
explain: The second 有的 can stand without a noun.

prompt: Which sentence says: Some people are singing and some are dancing?
options: 有的人在唱歌，有的人在跳舞。
有的人在唱歌，有的人跳舞在。
zh: 有的人在唱歌，有的人在跳舞。
en: Some people are singing and some are dancing.
explain: 在 comes before the verb.

zh: 有的学生走路，有的学生坐车。
en: Some students walk and some take a bus.
explain: 有的 … 有的 … sets two groups side by side.

zh: 有的菜很辣，有的菜不辣。
en: Some dishes are spicy and some are not.
explain: 有的 … 有的 … sets two groups side by side.

zh: 有的人喜欢跑步，有的人喜欢游泳。
en: Some people like running and some like swimming.
wrong: 有的人喜欢跑步，有的人了喜欢游泳。
explain: Do not put 了 before the verb here.

prompt: Which sentence says: We understand each other?
en: We understand each other.
explain: 互相 comes before the verb.

en: We have hobbies in common.
explain: 共同 + 的 + noun.

zh: 两个人共同完成了工作。
en: The two people finished the work together.
explain: 共同 comes before the verb.

en: They understand each other.
wrong: 他们互相一起理解。
explain: 互相 already means each other; do not add 一起.

zh: 他以前住在这里，当时他还是学生。
en: He used to live here; at that time he was still a student.
explain: 当时 points back to a time already named.

prompt: Which sentence says: Before going out, I must turn off the light?
en: Before going out, I must turn off the light.
explain: 之前 follows the first action.

zh: 三点和五点之间，我有空。
en: Between 3 and 5 o'clock, I am free.
explain: A 和 B 之间 means between A and B.

zh: 那是五年前的事，当时我还小。
en: That was 5 years ago; at that time I was still young.
explain: 当时 means at that time.

en: After the trip, he has become thinner.
explain: 之后 follows the first action.

zh: 考试之前，他每天都复习。
en: Before the exam, he reviews every day.
explain: 之前 follows the first action.

zh: 回家之前，请给我打电话。
en: Before going home, please call me.
wrong: 回家之前以前，请给我打电话。
explain: 之前 already means before; do not add 以前.

en: He washes his hands first, then eats.
explain: 接着 = then, next.

en: From then on, he is never late again.
explain: 从此 = from then on.

en: He reads first, then does homework.
explain: 接着 follows the first action.

prompt: Which sentence says: He drank tea, and then read?
en: He drank tea, and then read.
explain: 接着 comes before the next action.

zh: 她搬到北方了，从此很少回家。
en: She has moved to the north, and from then on she rarely goes home.
explain: 从此 means from then on.

en: He eats first, then takes a bath.
explain: 先 … 接着 … gives the order.

zh: 他先写作业，接着看电视。
en: He does homework first, then watches TV.
wrong: 他先写作业，接着然后看电视。
explain: 接着 already means then; do not add 然后.

en: They said the same words.
explain: 同样的 + noun = the same.

zh: 这两个词的意思不相同。
en: The meanings of these two words are not the same.
explain: 相同 comes after 不.

prompt: Which sentence says: He is equally busy?
en: He is equally busy.
explain: 同样 comes before the quality word.

en: They bought the same phone.
explain: 同样 + 的 + noun.

en: The price of these two books is the same.
explain: 相同 comes at the end.

en: Our opinions are the same.
wrong: 我们的意见相同一样。
explain: 相同 already means the same; do not add 一样.

prompt: Which sentence says: This result shows that he is clever?
options: 这个结果说明他很聪明。
这个结果他说明很聪明。
zh: 这个结果说明他很聪明。
en: This result shows that he is clever.
explain: 说明 follows the thing that shows.

en: He smiled to show agreement.
explain: 表示 means to show.

en: He wants to become a good teacher.
explain: 成为 means to become.

en: He soon became a manager.
explain: 成为 + role.

en: The teacher explained the reason.
explain: 说明 means to explain.

en: He became a doctor.
wrong: 他成为是了医生。
explain: 成为 already means become; do not add 是.

prompt: Which sentence says: He bought fruit such as apples and bananas?
options: 他买了苹果、香蕉等水果。
他买了等苹果、香蕉水果。
zh: 他买了苹果、香蕉等水果。
en: He bought fruit such as apples and bananas.
explain: 等 comes after the list.

zh: 衣服还没有干，我明天再穿。
en: The clothes are not dry yet; I will wear them tomorrow.
explain: 干 can mean dry.

en: I am not free tomorrow.
explain: 空 can mean free time.

en: I planted a tree in front of my house.
explain: 种 can mean to plant.

en: He fell asleep in the car.
wrong: 他在车上睡着觉了。
explain: 睡着 means fall asleep; do not add 觉.

en: 0.5 is the same as 1/2.
explain: Decimals use 点.

prompt: Which sentence says: Three quarters of the people agreed?
en: Three quarters (3/4) of the people agreed.
explain: The bottom number (4) comes first.

en: Eighty percent of the people agree.
explain: 百分之 + number.

prompt: Which sentence says: This watermelon weighs 3.5 kilos?
en: This watermelon weighs 3.5 kilos.
explain: Decimals use 点.

prompt: Which sentence says: This room is three times as big as that one?
options: 这个房间是那个的三倍大。
这个房间是三倍那个的大。
zh: 这个房间是那个的三倍大。
en: This room is three times as big as that one.
explain: A 是 B 的 + number + 倍.

zh: 今年的游客比去年多了一倍。
en: There are twice as many visitors this year as last year.
explain: 多了一倍: doubled.

en: My older brother has three times as many books as me.
explain: A 是 B 的 三倍.

prompt: Which sentence says: Things have got twice as expensive?
en: Things have got twice as expensive.
explain: Adjective + 了一倍: doubled.

prompt: Which sentence says: About thirty people came?
en: About thirty people came.
explain: 来 goes after the round number.

en: He looks about forty.
explain: Round number + 来 + 岁.

en: This watermelon is about ten kilos.
explain: 十来: about ten.

prompt: Which sentence says: There are about a hundred students in the school?
options: 学校里有一百来个学生。
学校里有一来百个学生。
zh: 学校里有一百来个学生。
en: There are about a hundred students in the school.
explain: 一百来个: about a hundred.

prompt: Which sentence says: I ate a big bowl of rice?
en: I ate a big bowl of rice.
explain: 一 + adjective + measure word.

en: He drank a small cup of coffee.
explain: 一小杯: a small cup.

en: A whole roomful of people came.
explain: 一屋子: a roomful.

prompt: Which sentence says: He ran in, looking excited?
options: 他一脸兴奋地跑了进来。
他一个脸兴奋地跑了进来。
zh: 他一脸兴奋地跑了进来。
en: He ran in, looking excited.
explain: 一脸 + feeling, no 个.

prompt: Which sentence says: This dish is not only cheap but also tasty?
options: 这个菜不仅便宜，而且好吃。
这个菜不仅便宜，而是好吃。
zh: 这个菜不仅便宜，而且好吃。
en: This dish is not only cheap but also tasty.
explain: 不仅 … 而且 ….

en: She is not only pretty but also clever.
explain: 不光 … 还 ….

zh: 我们不仅要会说，还要会写。
en: We must be able not only to speak but also to write.
explain: 不仅 … 还 ….

prompt: Which sentence says: He can not only sing but also dance?
options: 他不仅会唱歌，还会跳舞。
他不仅会唱歌，就会跳舞。
zh: 他不仅会唱歌，还会跳舞。
en: He can not only sing but also dance.
explain: The second half uses 还 or 而且.

zh: 一方面我想去，另一方面我没有时间。
en: On the one hand I want to go; on the other I have no time.
explain: The second half is 另一方面.

prompt: Which sentence says: Learning Chinese is interesting on the one hand and useful on the other?
options: 学汉语一方面有意思，另一方面很有用。
学汉语一方面有意思，另方面很有用。
zh: 学汉语一方面有意思，另一方面很有用。
en: Learning Chinese is interesting on the one hand and useful on the other.
explain: 另一方面 keeps the 一.

prompt: Which sentence says: On the one hand study hard, on the other also rest?
options: 一方面要努力学习，另一方面也要注意休息。
一方面要努力学习，二方面也要注意休息。
zh: 一方面要努力学习，另一方面也要注意休息。
en: On the one hand you need to study hard; on the other you need to rest too.
explain: Not 二方面: the second half is 另一方面.

zh: 一方面他很聪明，另一方面他很努力。
en: On the one hand he is clever; on the other he works hard.
explain: 一方面 … 另一方面 ….

prompt: Which sentence says: He is either in the office or in a meeting?
options: 他不是在办公室，就是在开会。
他不是在办公室，就在开会。
zh: 他不是在办公室，就是在开会。
en: He is either in the office or in a meeting.
explain: Use 就是 in the second half.

zh: 周末我不是看书，就是睡觉。
en: At weekends I either read or sleep.
explain: 不是 … 就是 ….

zh: 这几天不是刮风，就是下雨。
en: These days it is either windy or raining.
explain: 不是 … 就是 …: one or the other.

prompt: Which sentence corrects a mistake: He is not a teacher but a student?
en: He is not a teacher but a student.
explain: 不是…而是… corrects; 不是…就是… gives two choices.

prompt: Which sentence says: My book was borrowed by a classmate?
en: My book was borrowed by a classmate.
explain: 叫 needs the doer after it.

en: The cake was eaten up by the children.
explain: Thing + 让 + doer + verb + result.

prompt: Which sentence says: The cup was broken by him?
en: The cup was broken by him.
explain: 让 needs the doer after it.

zh: 我的自行车叫人骑走了。
en: Someone rode off on my bike.
explain: 叫 + 人 when you do not know who.

en: Give your clothes a wash.
explain: 把 + thing + verb 一 verb.

prompt: Which sentence says: I forgot the password?
en: I forgot the password.
explain: The verb needs 了 after it.

en: He gave me a scolding.
explain: 把 + person + verb + 了一顿.

prompt: Which sentence says: Don't throw rubbish on the ground?
en: Don't throw rubbish on the ground.
explain: 把 + thing comes before 往 + place.

en: It's boiling today.
explain: Adjective + 死了.

prompt: Which sentence says: I'm starving?
en: I'm starving.
explain: 死了 comes after the adjective.

en: She has been terribly busy lately.
explain: Adjective + 得厉害.

prompt: Which sentence says (casually): I'm dead tired?
en: I'm dead tired.
explain: Adjective first, then 死了.

prompt: Which sentence means: I don't know?
en: How would I know?
explain: 怎么知道？ said this way means "I don't know".

zh: 这么好吃的菜，谁不喜欢？
en: Who wouldn't like such tasty food?
explain: 谁不…？ means everyone would.

en: Who doesn't want to travel?
explain: 谁不 + verb?

prompt: Which sentence means: this isn't hard at all?
en: What's so hard about this?
explain: 有什么 + adjective + 的？

zh: 这件事我不能不告诉他。
en: I have to tell him about this.
explain: 不能不: must.

prompt: Which sentence means: everyone came?
en: Not one person stayed away.
explain: Two negatives: everyone.

en: Every student likes him.
explain: 没有 … 不 …: all.

prompt: Which sentence says: I have no choice but to go?
en: I have no choice but to go.
explain: 不得不 + verb.

prompt: Which sentence says: It's really cold today?
en: It's really cold today.
explain: Keep the 的.

zh: 他的汉语说得真够好的。
en: His Chinese is really good.
explain: 够 + adjective + 的.

en: This bag is really expensive.
explain: 够 + adjective + 的.

prompt: Which sentence says: You are really busy!
en: You are really busy!
explain: 够 comes before the adjective.

en: Each child is taller than the last.
explain: 一个比一个.

zh: 他的成绩一次比一次好。
en: His grades get better every time.
explain: 一次比一次 + adjective.

prompt: Which sentence says: Life is getting better day by day?
en: Life is getting better day by day.
explain: 比 goes between the two 一天.

zh: 这里的游客一年比一年多。
en: There are more visitors here every year.
explain: 一年比一年 + adjective.

prompt: Which sentence says: When it comes to health, she is very careful?
options: 在健康方面，她非常注意。
在方面健康，她非常注意。
zh: 在健康方面，她非常注意。
en: When it comes to health, she is very careful.
explain: 在 + area + 方面.

zh: 在语言方面，他是我的老师。

explain: 在 … 方面 at the start.

en: When it comes to work, he is very serious.
explain: 在 + area + 方面.

prompt: Which sentence says: When it comes to money, he is careful?
en: When it comes to money, he is careful.
explain: 方面 stays right after the area.

en: He runs every day for his health.
explain: 为了 + reason + 而 + action.

options: 我们不应该只为了考试而学习。
我们不应该只为了考试学习而。
zh: 我们不应该只为了考试而学习。
en: We should not study only for exams.
explain: 而 comes before the action.

en: She came to China to study Chinese.
explain: 为了 … 而 ….

en: Work hard for your dream.
explain: 为了 … 而 + verb.

zh: 拿我来说，我每天都锻炼。
en: Take me, for example: I exercise every day.
explain: 拿 … 来说.

zh: 拿我来说，我最爱吃米饭。
en: Take me: I love rice most.
explain: 拿 + example + 来说.

prompt: Which sentence says: My friends are all busy. Take my sister: she works ten hours a day?
options: 我的朋友都很忙，拿我姐姐来说，她每天工作十个小时。
我的朋友都很忙，拿来说我姐姐，她每天工作十个小时。
zh: 我的朋友都很忙，拿我姐姐来说，她每天工作十个小时。
en: My friends are all busy. Take my sister: she works ten hours a day.
explain: The example goes between 拿 and 来说.

zh: 拿我来说，我不太喜欢运动。
en: Take me: I don't much like sport.
explain: 拿 … 来说 at the start.

zh: 就是再忙，我也会给你打电话。
en: Even if I'm really busy, I will call you.
explain: 就是 … 也 ….

en: Even if it is hard, I want to learn it.
explain: 就是 … 也 ….

prompt: Which sentence says: Even if you don't come, we will start?
options: 你就是不来，我们也要开始。
你就是不来，我们就要开始。
zh: 你就是不来，我们也要开始。
en: Even if you don't come, we will start.
explain: 就是 (even if) goes with 也.

zh: 就是没有人帮我，我也能做完。
en: Even if nobody helps me, I can finish it.
explain: 就是 … 也 …: even if.

prompt: Which sentence says: I know even if you don't tell me?
en: I know even if you don't tell me.
explain: 不 … 也 ….

zh: 今天晚上我不睡觉也要把它做完。
en: Tonight I'll finish it even if I don't sleep.
explain: 不 + verb + 也 ….

en: He'll finish reading even if he doesn't eat.
explain: 不 + verb + 也要.

prompt: Which sentence says: My family has two dogs, a big one and a small one?
options: 我家有两只狗，一大一小。
我家有两只狗，一大小一。
zh: 我家有两只狗，一大一小。
en: My family has two dogs: a big one and a small one.
explain: 一大一小.

zh: 我们一左一右坐在他两边。
en: We sat on both sides of him, one on each side.
explain: 一左一右: one on each side.

zh: 老师一字一句地读课文。
en: The teacher reads the text word by word.
explain: 一字一句.

prompt: Which sentence says: The two of them walk one behind the other?
options: 两个人一前一后地走着。
两个人一前后一地走着。
zh: 两个人一前一后地走着。
en: The two of them walk one behind the other.
explain: 一前一后.

zh: 他无儿无女，一个人生活。

explain: 无儿无女.

en: That old man has no children.
explain: 无A无B.

prompt: Which sentence says: He has no children?
en: He has no children.
explain: 无 means "without".

prompt: Which sentence says: They came out chatting and laughing?
options: 他们有说有笑地走了出来。
他们说有笑有地走了出来。
zh: 他们有说有笑地走了出来。
en: They came out chatting and laughing.
explain: 有 comes before each verb.

zh: 这里有山有水，非常漂亮。
en: With hills and water, it is very beautiful here.
explain: 有山有水.

zh: 过年的时候家里有吃有喝。
en: At New Year there is plenty to eat and drink at home.
explain: 有吃有喝.

prompt: Which sentence says: Everyone is chatting and laughing?
en: Everyone is chatting and laughing.
explain: No 和 inside the pattern.

prompt: Which sentence says: There will be plenty of chances later?
en: There will be plenty of chances later.
explain: 有的是 + noun.

prompt: Which sentence says: His family has plenty of money?

explain: 有的是 stays together.

en: Don't rush, we have plenty of time.
explain: 有的是 + 时间.

prompt: Which sentence says: He has plenty of ways to do it?
en: He has plenty of ways to do it.
explain: 有的是 "plenty", not 有的 "some".

en: He may have left already.
explain: 说不定 before the verb.

en: It may rain tomorrow.
explain: 说不定: maybe.

prompt: Which sentence says: Maybe she doesn't know?
en: Maybe she doesn't know.
explain: 说不定 stays together.

prompt: Which sentence says: It is not certain yet whether he will come?
en: It is not certain yet whether he will come.
explain: 还说不定: not certain yet.

en: This dish is not very tasty.
explain: 不怎么 + adjective.

prompt: Which sentence says: I don't watch TV much?
en: I don't watch TV much.
explain: 不怎么: not much. 怎么不 asks "why not?".

en: He hasn't been coming much lately.
explain: 不怎么 + verb.

prompt: Which sentence says: This film is not great?
en: This film is not great.
explain: On its own use 不怎么样; 不怎么 needs a verb or adjective.

zh: 他没回答，这就是说，他不同意。
en: He didn't answer; that is to say, he doesn't agree.
explain: 这就是说: in other words.

prompt: Which sentence says: In other words, we have to start again?
options: 这就是说，我们得重新开始。
这说就是，我们得重新开始。
zh: 这就是说，我们得重新开始。
en: In other words, we have to start again.
explain: 就是说 stays together.

zh: 就是说，你明天不用来了。
en: That is to say, you don't need to come tomorrow.
explain: 就是说 at the start.

en: Mom told him off for coming home too late.
explain: 批评 + person + what they did.

en: We chose him as manager.
explain: 选 + person + 当 + role.

prompt: Which sentence says: The teacher praised him for working hard?
en: The teacher praised him for working hard.
explain: The person comes right after 表扬.

en: The teacher praised me for doing well in the exam.
explain: 表扬 + person + what they did well.

zh: 这么多东西，你拿得了吗？
en: Can you carry all these things?
explain: Verb + 得了: can manage.

prompt: Which sentence says: I can't come tomorrow?
en: I can't come tomorrow.
explain: 来不了 is "can't"; 不来了 is "won't come any more".

en: He can't solve this problem.
explain: Verb + 不了.

prompt: Which sentence asks: Can you manage it today?
en: Can you manage it today?
explain: Verb + 得了.

en: I will never drink again.
explain: 再也不.

en: He never came again.
explain: 再也没 + verb + 过.

prompt: Which sentence says: I will never believe him again?
en: I will never believe him again.
explain: 再也 comes before 不.

prompt: Which sentence says: After that I never saw her again?
options: 从那以后，我再也没见过她。
从那以后，我没再也见过她。
zh: 从那以后，我再也没见过她。
en: After that I never saw her again.
explain: 再也 comes before 没.

prompt: Which sentence says: However hard they looked, they couldn't find it?
en: However hard they looked, they couldn't find it.
explain: 怎么都 + 不.

zh: 我怎么也打不开这个门。
en: However hard I try, I can't open this door.
explain: 怎么也 + verb 不 + result.

zh: 这个字我怎么也记不住。
en: However hard I try, I can't remember this character.
explain: 怎么也 … 不 ….

prompt: Which sentence says: However I put it, he doesn't understand?
en: However I put it, he doesn't understand.
explain: 怎么 + verb … 都不.

prompt: Which sentence says: What is there to worry about?
en: What is there to worry about?
explain: 有什么好 + feeling + 的.

en: What's so good to look at?
explain: 有什么 + 好看 + 的?

en: There's nothing to be sad about.
explain: 没有什么好 … 的.

prompt: Which sentence says: Work is work and life is life?
options: 工作是工作，生活是生活。
工作是生活，生活是工作。
zh: 工作是工作，生活是生活。
en: Work is work and life is life.
explain: Each thing is said twice.

en: You are you and I am I.
explain: X是X，Y是Y.

prompt: Which sentence says: He is he, I am I; we are different?
options: 他是他，我是我，我们不一样。
他是我，我是他，我们不一样。
zh: 他是他，我是我，我们不一样。
en: He is he, I am I; we are different.
explain: X是X keeps the two apart.

zh: 这件事你做也得做，不做也得做。
en: You have to do this, like it or not.
explain: X也得X，不X也得X.

prompt: Which sentence says: You have to take this medicine, like it or not?
options: 这个药你吃也得吃，不吃也得吃。
这个药你吃也吃，不吃也吃。
zh: 这个药你吃也得吃，不吃也得吃。
en: You have to take this medicine, like it or not.
explain: 也得 in both halves.

prompt: Which sentence says: Tomorrow you have to come, like it or not?
options: 明天你来也得来，不来也得来。
明天你来也得来，不来就得来。
zh: 明天你来也得来，不来也得来。
en: Tomorrow you have to come, like it or not.
explain: Both halves use 也得.

prompt: Which sentence says: Don't worry, I'll do it, that's all?
en: Relax, I'll do it, that's all.
explain: Verb + 就是了.

en: If you don't want to go, just don't go.
explain: 就是了 at the end.

en: If you have a question, just ask.
explain: Verb + 就是了.

zh: 还大学生呢，这么简单的字都不认识。

explain: 还 + noun + 呢.

prompt: Which sentence says: Some good friend you are: you even forgot my birthday.
options: 还好朋友呢，生日都忘了。
是好朋友呢，生日都忘了。
zh: 还好朋友呢，生日都忘了。
en: Some good friend you are: you even forgot my birthday.
explain: 还 … 呢 mocks.

en: Some teacher you are: you don't even know this.
explain: 还 + noun + 呢.

zh: 我们只能走一步是一步。
en: We can only take it one step at a time.
explain: Verb + 一X是一X.

prompt: Which sentence says: He just lives one day at a time?
en: He just lives one day at a time.
explain: Verb first: 过一天是一天.

prompt: Which sentence says: Let's take it one step at a time?
en: Let's take it one step at a time.
explain: The pattern uses 是.

prompt: Which sentence says: Get on with your work, don't mind me?
en: Get on with your work, don't mind me.
explain: 你 + verb + 你的.

zh: 你看你的书吧，我出去一下。

explain: 你 + verb + 你的.

en: You go ahead and have fun.
explain: 你们 + verb + 你们的.

en: When you are told to rest, just rest.
explain: 让你X你就X.

prompt: Which sentence says: When the doctor tells you to take medicine, just take it?
options: 医生让你吃药，你就吃药。
医生让你吃药，你吃就药。
zh: 医生让你吃药，你就吃药。
en: When the doctor tells you to take medicine, just take it.
explain: 你就 + the same verb.

zh: 妈妈让你回家，你就回家。
en: When Mom tells you to come home, just come home.
explain: 让你X你就X.

prompt: Which sentence says: Whatever happens, I must finish today?
options: 我说什么也得今天做完。
我什么说也得今天做完。
zh: 我说什么也得今天做完。
en: Whatever happens, I must finish today.
explain: 说什么也得.

en: This time I must go, whatever happens.
explain: 说什么也得 + verb.

en: He won't agree, whatever you say.
explain: 说什么也不: won't, whatever happens.

prompt: Which sentence says: All right, let's go then?
en: All right, let's go then.
explain: X就X吧.

en: Fine, let's eat then; I'm hungry too.
explain: X就X吧.

zh: 换就换吧，这个也不太好。
en: Fine, change it then; this one isn't very good.
explain: X就X吧: fine, then.

zh: 我们讨论是讨论了，可是还没决定。
en: We did discuss it, but we haven't decided yet.
explain: X是X了，可是 ….

prompt: Which sentence says: This phone is good all right, it's just too expensive?
options: 这个手机好是好，就是太贵了。
这个手机是好好，就是太贵了。
zh: 这个手机好是好，就是太贵了。
en: This phone is good all right, it's just too expensive.
explain: X是X, then 就是.

zh: 这家饭店近是近，可是菜不好吃。
en: This restaurant is close all right, but the food isn't good.
explain: X是X，可是 ….
